en.同一份模型也能供 Agent 阅读：{objects} 个源对象、{fields: The same model is available for agents to read: {objects} source objects, {fields} fields and {definitions} definitions.
en.记录不预装到上下文；需要时按来源和权限读取。: Record rows are read on demand from their authorised source, rather than preloaded into context.
en.此页尚未连接工作台 Agent；这里只预览可交付内容，不会自动启动问答。: This page is not connected to a workbench agent. It previews deliverable context and does not start a conversation.
en.未确认的定义仍带未确认状态，不能当作已经批准的业务规则。: Unreviewed definitions keep that state; they are not approved business rules.
en.阶段一：先看有没有漏数据: Phase 1: check for missing source data
en.这里列出扫描到的源表、数据库视图和字段。先确认范围完整，再核对每个字段；这一步不: These are the scanned tables, database views and fields. Check coverage first, then individual fields. This step adds no business rules.
en.找到一张表和它的字段: Find a table and its fields
en.目录里的“{object}”来自源库。点名称看关联，点旁边箭头展开字段；不是另外: The catalogue entry {object} comes from the source database. Its name opens relationships; the arrow expands its fields. Both use the same source facts.
en.目录按数据源和对象列出已有内容。这里没有可演示的字段，不会为引导虚构数据。: The catalogue lists existing sources and objects. No field is available for this step; the tour does not invent one.
en.现在打开的是“{field}”。这里能看源类型、主键和原库定义；字段名字还不能代: You are viewing {field}. Inspect its source type, key and original definition. A column name alone does not establish its business meaning.
en.这就是“{field}”的源值。同一条记录的字段放在一起，并保留主键；可用上一页: These are original values for {field}. Fields from the same record stay together with its key. Use Previous and Next to page through the records.
en.这个橙色问题还不是结论。看下面的核对方法，再查源 SQL 或真实记录；问题本身不: This orange question is not a finding. Follow the verification plan and inspect source SQL or records. The question does not rewrite source data.
en.现在核对“{subject}”。业务视图把这个目标和相关规则、问题放在一起，沿用: Review {subject}. Its business view brings the objective, related rules and questions together, using the same source fields as phase 1.
en.这条定义说明给谁用、支持什么决策。请核对它是否真是你的意思；引用的字段能带你回到: This definition names its stakeholder and decision. Check whether it expresses what you mean. Follow its field references back to source data.
en.这里的“{issue}”仍待确认。业务规则不能靠编译通过就算正确，需要你和 Ag: {issue} still needs a decision. Successful compilation does not approve its business meaning; review it together with the agent.
en.点这个按钮或选中文字，可以写具体修正。Agent 修改定义后要通过编译检查，再生: Use this button or select text to suggest a correction. Agent edits must pass compiler checks before the graph is regenerated for review. The tour sends no comment for you.
en.在支持评论的审阅页，可选中文字提出修正。Agent 修改定义后要通过编译检查，再: In a review host with comments, select text to suggest a correction. Agent edits must pass compiler checks before regeneration. This offline page cannot send comments.
en.当前模型还没有业务定义。先说清楚要解决什么业务问题，再由 Agent 提交定义；: This model has no business definitions yet. State the business problem, then have the agent submit definitions. Business views appear after those definitions pass compilation.
en.阶段三：让 Agent 使用同一份业务知识: Phase 3: let the agent use the same knowledge
en.人看的图和 Agent 读的内容来自同一模型。这里预览可交付的源结构、业务定义和: The graph and agent context come from the same model. Preview source structure, business definitions and evidence here. Record rows remain on demand.
en.完整问答还需要接通工作台: Connect the workbench for real conversations
en.这个静态审阅页还未绑定工作台 Agent。真实问答要在绑定的对话中进行；这里不模: This static review page is not bound to a workbench agent. Real questions belong in that bound conversation; this preview does not simulate a completed business answer.
en.最后检验 Agent 是否读对: Check whether the agent reads correctly
en.这里有基于原库生成的题，标准答案留在裁判端。没运行就没有得分；这些题检查读数，业: These questions come from the source; reference answers stay with the private judge. There is no score before a run. They test source reading; business understanding needs additional evaluation.
en.引导未能定位“{step}”，已退出；可以重新打开。: The walkthrough could not locate {step} and exited. You can open it again.
en.正在核对什么问题？从视图进入，沿引用查看依据，再评论矫正。: What are we checking? Start with a review view, follow its references to the evidence, then comment to correct it.
en.字段在哪里、原值是什么？展开目录查找字段，选择对象或字段查看关联与真实记录。: Where is the field, and what are its original values? Expand the catalogue to find fields; select an object or field to inspect relationships and real records.
en.以后不再自动显示（仍可从使用引导打开）: Do not show automatically again (Quick tour stays available)
en.在“视图与目录”中选择要核对的问题。数据投影展示源库事实；业务视图展示引用这些事: In Views and catalogue, choose the question to review. Data projection shows source facts; business views show meanings and rules that reference those facts.
en.沿目录找到字段: Find a field in the catalogue
en.展开数据源、对象和字段。选择对象或字段会显示关联子图；目录顶层回到完整源图。: Expand sources, objects and fields. Select an object or field to open its related subgraph; the catalogue root returns to the complete source graph.
en.点击字段或对象查看详情，再打开示例或分页记录。同一行的字段一起显示；可见范围由服: Select a field or object for details, then open sample or paginated records. Fields from the same row stay together; server authorization determines visibility.
en.选中文字或使用节点评论按钮提出疑问。评论绑定稳定对象身份；LLM 修改定义后由: Select text or use a node comment button to ask a question. Comments use stable object identities. The compiler checks LLM edits before regenerating the graph for review.
en.核对字段、定义与依据。支持评论的审阅宿主还可收集疑问；LLM 修改定义后由 co: Check fields, definitions and evidence. A review host with comments can also collect questions. The compiler checks LLM edits before regenerating the graph for review.
en.以下关联来自数据库视图的 SQL；这是查询来源，不代表业务规则或完整字段血缘。: These relationships come from database view SQL. They are query sources, not business rules or complete field lineage.
en.记录从详情下钻；数据库视图和二进制字段也保留在投影中。: Inspect records from details. Database views and binary fields are included.
en.按核对任务组织；下方目录按源库结构组织，两者引用同一模型。: Views group review tasks; the catalogue below follows source structure. Both reference the same model.
en.选择视图，或在数据投影下展开数据源、对象和字段。顶层显示完整源图，对象和字段显示: Choose a view, or expand sources, objects and fields under Data projection. The top level shows the full source graph; objects and fields open related subgraphs.
en.子视图 · {shown}/{total} 个源对象 · 范围内未显示 {out: Subgraph · {shown}/{total} source objects · {outside} outside this display · {edges} boundary relationships
en.点击名称查看关联子图；展开箭头查看下一级。表与数据库视图都属于阶段一。: Click a name for its related subgraph; expand the arrow for the next level. Tables and database views are both phase-one sources.
en.按声明的外键与源 SQL 依赖分为 {count} 个关联分组；这不是已确认的业: Declared foreign keys and source SQL dependencies form {count} structural groups. These are not confirmed business domains.
en.检查已有指标的计算是否自洽；不证明业务口径正确。: Check the consistency of existing metric calculations; this does not confirm business meaning.
en.按源目录生成题目；检验 agent 能否通过投影读对数据。: Questions generated from the source catalogue test whether an agent can read data correctly through the projection.
en.覆盖清单用于检查表、视图、字段和记录是否遗漏，不是答题分数。: Coverage lists tables, views, fields and records to check for omissions; it is not an answer score.
en.fCoSE 结果有节点重叠，当前使用 ELK 布局。: fCoSE produced overlapping nodes; using the ELK layout.
en.按数据库对象类型筛选；不是业务视图，也不改变源库覆盖或访问权限。: Filter by database object type. This is not a business view and does not change source coverage or access rights.
en.尚无可执行指标的计算自检；源数据题库已自动生成。: No executable-metric self-checks are available; source questions are generated automatically.
en.{object} 有多少条记录？: How many records of {object} are represented?
en.{object} 中 {field} 已填写、但没有匹配 {target} 记录: How many {object} records have a populated {field} without a matching {target} record?
en.源对象通过只读连接从这个数据源取得；连接配置留在受控环境中。: Source objects are read through this data source. Connection configuration stays in the controlled environment.
en.这里是导出时的来源快照，不是实时连接状态。: This is source provenance at export time, not live connection status.
en.标识的是源字段，用于绑定字段评论、来源定位和业务规则引用。: Identifies this source field for comments, source navigation and business-rule references.
en.标识的是整个源对象，不是其中某条记录。: Identifies the whole source object, not an individual record.
en.展示名、语言、布局和折叠变化不会改变标识；源库搬迁或源字段真正改名需要迁移引用。: Display names, language, layout and folding do not change this identity. Moving the source or renaming its actual fields requires reference migration.
en.源库声明了字段之间的关联；点击一项查看两端和原始声明。: The database declares these field relationships. Open an item to inspect both endpoints and the original declaration.
en.以下关联来自源视图的 SQL；这是查询来源，不代表业务规则或完整字段血缘。: These relationships come from source view SQL. They are query sources, not business rules or complete field lineage.
en.在图上查看这条关联: Show this relationship on the graph
en.{shown}/{total} 个关系名称已显示；其余可点线查看。: {shown}/{total} relationship names shown; click the remaining edges for details.
en.关系名称见详情；可只看相邻关系缩小范围。: Open edges for their names, or focus on neighbouring relationships to reduce the scope.
en.依赖解析未完成；保留源 SQL 定义。: Dependency parsing is incomplete; the source SQL definition is preserved.
en.源库未提供字段说明；可在字段上评论补充业务定义。: The source has no field description. Comment on the field to propose a business definition.
en.记录用于核对字段；业务定义不会改写源值。: Records help verify fields; business definitions do not overwrite source values.
en.未声明主键；这里的序号只在本次快照内定位，不是业务身份。: No declared primary key. Positions locate rows within this snapshot and are not business identities.
en.展开表查看字段，点击字段核对来源或添加评论。: Expand a table to see fields; select a field to inspect its source or comment.
en.记录从详情下钻；源视图和二进制字段也保留在投影中。: Inspect records from details. Source views and binary fields are included.
en.全部源对象与字段已呈现；记录来自只读快照。: All source objects and fields are represented; records come from a read-only snapshot.
en.点一个节点看它的来历。: Select a node to inspect its source.
en.{count} 行，没有取进来；它的合计由库直接算。: {count} rows are not fetched; aggregates run in the database.
en.{count} 条全部通过。点一个节点看它的来历。: All {count} checks passed. Select a node to inspect its source.
en.由上面的{entry}带动，不另计入{total}。: Carried from {entry} above; not counted again in {total}.
en.选中部分 + 排除部分 = 全部（NULL 可能留下缺口）: Selected + excluded = whole (NULL can leave a gap)
en.{passed}/{total} 题通过；分数不阻止修改。: {passed}/{total} questions passed; scores do not block changes.
en.这些题检查计算性质，不证明业务定义正确。: These questions check computational properties, not business definitions.
en.数据投影：核对对象、列、主键和关联；业务指标在另一视图。: Data projection: review objects, columns, identities and relationships. Metrics are in the other view.
en.无需取回全部明细即可计算。: Computed without fetching every source row.
en.每条来源记录最多关联一条目标记录；多个来源记录可以指向同一目标。: Each source record refers to at most one target; many source records may share a target.
en.此导出未包含记录页；请在受控服务中打开，或由有权限的发布者导出记录。: This export has no record pages. Use the controlled service or request an authorised record export.
en.类型 → 分页记录 → 属性与关系: Type → Record pages → Properties and relationships
en.已核对源库清单；部分内容未进入记录图。: Source inventory checked; some content is not included in the record graph.
en.题目来自原库；标准答案仅在裁判端。尚未完成隔离 LLM 答题，暂无得分。: Questions come from the source database; answers stay with the judge. No isolated LLM run or score yet.
en.同一来源主键的两个业务投影；各自筛选可能不同。: Two business projections share the same source key; their filters may differ.
en.拖动节点边缘调整位置；选中文字可评论。: Drag node borders to arrange; select text to comment.
en.本次仅隔离会话上下文，未做操作系统沙箱隔离；三题不代表整体准确率。: This trial used a fresh conversation, without an OS sandbox. Three questions do not establish overall accuracy.
en.仅显示此授权视图；其他范围可能不可见。: Only this authorised view is shown; other scopes may be unavailable.
en.阶段一：只读原库投影，未定义业务口径。: Phase one: read-only source projection, without business definitions.
en.查看数据库中的记录、字段和关联。: Browse database records, fields and relationships.
en.快照不随源库自动更新；空值保持原样。: This snapshot does not update automatically; empty values are preserved.
en.快照不随源库自动更新；NULL 保持为空，不推断为零或业务缺口。: Snapshots do not update automatically; NULL stays empty, without inferred zeros or business gaps.
en.待绑定源字段：概念已建立，尚不能据此计算数据。: Awaiting source binding: this concept exists, but cannot yet calculate data.
en.源 SQL 和结果仍属于阶段一；这里核对业务含义和新的假设。: Source SQL and results remain in phase one. Review business meanings and new hypotheses here.
en.点击定义查看出处，沿源字段核对真实记录。: Select a definition to inspect its evidence and follow source fields to real records.
en.本版只记录定义与问题；口径确认后再实现指标计算。: This version records definitions and questions. Metric execution follows review of the business definition.
en.这条线引用源对象或字段；不是源库外键，也不是新的计算公式。: This edge references a source object or field. It is not a source foreign key or a new calculation.
en.修改定义时递增版本；不是阶段编号或可信度评分。: Incremented when the definition changes; not a phase number or confidence score.
en.此对象有评论，可在评论侧栏查看。: This object has comments; read them in the comment sidebar.
en.橙色是待核对的问题，不表示源数据已经出错；不会改写源值。: Orange marks questions to check, not confirmed source defects. Source values stay unchanged.
en.源结构来自已编译版本；记录按需从源库读取。: Structure comes from the compiled model. Records are read from the source on demand.
en.无法读取源记录；请检查访问权限或刷新审阅页。: Unable to read source records. Check access or reload this review page.
en.实时记录；不同分页可能来自不同的读取时刻。: Live records. Separate pages may observe source changes.
en.未声明主键；序号仅在本次读取中定位，不是业务身份。: No primary key is declared. Positions identify rows within this read only, not business identities.
